issue_description: squealing noise when applying brakes, screeching brake sound, noise from disc brakes
likely_causes: Worn out brake pads or shoes
Accumulated dirt, dust, or moisture on the brake rotor/drum
typical_fix: Replace front/rear brake pads/shoes, clean the brake assembly with degreaser, or true/replace the disc rotor.

issue_description: spongy brakes, loose brake lever, brake lever goes all the way to handle, low brake fluid
likely_causes: Air bubbles trapped in the hydraulic brake line
typical_fix: Bleed the brakes to remove air pockets, replace degraded brake fluid, or rebuild the master cylinder.

issue_description: mileage has dropped, high petrol consumption, low fuel economy, engine consuming too much fuel
likely_causes: Out-of-tune carburetor or dirty fuel injector
typical_fix: Replace/clean the air filter, inflate tyres to correct PSI, clean and tune the carburetor, and replace the spark plug.

issue_description: black smoke from exhaust pipe, dark smoke from silencer, soot on spark plug
likely_causes: Choke valve stuck in closed position
typical_fix: Adjust carburetor fuel mixture screw, clean air filter, and inspect/service the choke cable mechanism.

issue_description: white smoke from silencer, light grey smoke, engine burning oil, smoke on acceleration
typical_fix: Perform engine top-end overhaul, replace piston rings, replace valve seals, and rebore the cylinder if necessary.

issue_description: clicking sound when starting, engine clicking but not starting, self start makes clicking noise
typical_fix: Recharge or replace the 12V battery, clean/tighten the battery terminals, or replace the starter relay.

issue_description: engine stalls at idle, bike turns off when idling at red light, engine stops when stopping
likely_causes: Clogged idle jet in the carburetor
Faulty spark plug or weak ignition spark
typical_fix: Adjust the idle screw to increase RPM, clean the carburetor jets, and check/replace the spark plug.

issue_description: engine sputtering at high speeds, engine misfire, bike jerks when accelerating fast
likely_causes: Dirty or clogged main carburetor jet
Faulty ignition coil or spark plug
typical_fix: Drain and flush the fuel tank, clean the carburetor jets, and replace the spark plug/ignition coil.

issue_description: engine overheating, engine feels very hot, loss of power when engine heats up
likely_causes: Extremely low engine oil level or degraded oil
Blocked cooling fins on the engine cylinder block
typical_fix: Perform engine oil change, clean dirt from cylinder cooling fins, and adjust valve clearance/ignition timing.

issue_description: oil leaking under engine, black spots on parking floor, oil stains on engine case
likely_causes: Degraded engine gaskets or rubber O-rings
typical_fix: Replace the drain bolt copper washer, replace leaky gaskets (clutch/magneto cover), or seal engine cracks.

issue_description: clicking noise from engine, ticking sound from engine cylinders, valve noise
likely_causes: Loose engine valves (tappets out of adjustment)
typical_fix: Adjust valve tappet clearances to factory spec, top up engine oil, or replace/tension the timing chain.

issue_description: engine knocking, metallic tapping sound, loud metallic thuds inside engine
likely_causes: Piston slap due to worn piston/cylinder wall
typical_fix: Perform a complete engine block rebuild, replace connecting rod/crankshaft bearings, or flush tank for high-quality petrol.

issue_description: petrol leaking from carburetor, fuel overflow, petrol smell near engine
likely_causes: Stuck float needle valve inside carburetor bowl
Heavy float block failing to rise
typical_fix: Clean the carburetor float bowl, replace the needle valve, and clear out dirt or varnish deposits.

issue_description: chain slipping, clicking noise from chain sprocket, chain making grinding sound
likely_causes: Worn out front and rear sprockets
typical_fix: Adjust the chain slackness, lubricate with chain spray, or replace the entire chain and sprocket kit.

issue_description: hard gear shifting, gear lever is stiff, gears not shifting smoothly
typical_fix: Replace engine oil with correct grade, adjust clutch cable free-play, or replace the clutch plates and pressure plates.

issue_description: clutch slipping, engine revs up but bike doesn't accelerate, bike lacks pickup when accelerating
likely_causes: No free play in clutch cable
typical_fix: Replace the clutch plates, adjust the clutch cable free-play, and replace clutch pressure springs.

issue_description: handlebar wobbling, unstable front wheel, bike pulls to one side, handle feels loose
likely_causes: Worn out steering cone set (t-cone bearings)
Bent front wheel rim or uneven tyre wear
typical_fix: Replace the steering cone set bearings, true/re-align the front wheel rim, or tighten steering bolts.

issue_description: hard suspension, bumpy ride, oil leaking from front shock absorbers, front forks bottoming out
likely_causes: Lack of fork oil or degraded fluid
typical_fix: Replace front fork oil seals, flush and refill fork oil, or replace the rear shock absorber assemblies.

issue_description: headlight dim, electrical lights flickering, battery not charging
typical_fix: Replace the RR unit regulator, replace/recharge the battery, or repair magneto stator coils.

issue_description: horn not working, weak horn sound, horn squeaks
typical_fix: Clean the terminal contacts, adjust the tone tuning screw on the back of the horn, or replace the horn.

issue_description: indicators not working, indicator blinking too fast, indicator stays solid
likely_causes: Loose indicator bulb or blown filament
typical_fix: Replace the flasher relay, replace the blown bulb, or clean/lubricate the indicator switch assembly.

issue_description: battery discharging quickly, battery dies overnight, self start stops working after parking
likely_causes: Degraded battery plates unable to hold charge
Short circuit in wiring harness draining battery
Faulty RR unit failing to charge battery
typical_fix: Replace the battery, inspect wiring harness for short circuit drains, or replace the regulator rectifier.

issue_description: sluggish acceleration, lag in pickup, engine gasps when opening throttle
likely_causes: Dirty carburetor carburetor slides or jets
Dirty fuel filter or fuel line block
typical_fix: Service and clean the carburetor, replace the inline fuel filter, or clean/replace spark plugs.

issue_description: squeaking noise from rear suspension, creaking rear spring sound
likely_causes: Lack of lubrication on swingarm bushes
Dry shock absorber joints or dirt entry
typical_fix: Lubricate the swingarm pivot bushes with grease, and clean/lube shock absorber bush attachments.

issue_description: spark plug carbon buildup, wet spark plug, engine misfires
likely_causes: Engine oil leaking into combustion chamber
typical_fix: Clean spark plug electrode with sandpaper, adjust fuel mixture screw, or replace spark plug/ignition coil.

issue_description: rust on exhaust pipe, loud exhaust blowing sound, hole in silencer
typical_fix: Replace the exhaust gasket, tighten flange bolts, weld holes, or apply high-heat anti-rust paint.

issue_description: flat tyre frequently, tyre air pressure leaking, tire loses pressure
likely_causes: Bent tyre valve pin or worn valve neck
Worn wheel rim borders leaking air
typical_fix: Replace the tyre valve core, repair tubeless tyre punctures, or seal wheel rim borders.

issue_description: engine vibration at high speeds, body rattling at high speeds, loose bike panels
likely_causes: Unbalanced wheels or worn swingarm bushes
typical_fix: Tighten all engine mounting chassis bolts, replace swingarm bushes, and secure body panels with rubber dampers.

issue_description: speedometer not working, speed needle stuck, odometer not updating
likely_causes: Worn out speed gear box at front wheel hub
typical_fix: Replace the speedometer inner cable, replace the front wheel speed gear kit, or inspect gauge connections.

issue_description: fuel gauge showing wrong level, fuel indicator not working
likely_causes: Faulty fuel tank sending float unit
Short circuit in fuel indicator wiring
typical_fix: Clean or replace the fuel tank sensor float assembly, and verify gauge connector continuity.

issue_description: cold start issues, hard to start in morning, engine crank but no start in winter
likely_causes: Incorrect spark plug gap or carbon deposits
typical_fix: Clean and re-gap the spark plug, adjust choke cable, and swap engine oil to manufacturer specified grade (e.g. 10W-30).

issue_description: kick starter slipping, kick lever loose, hard to kick start
likely_causes: Worn out clutch plates causing kick slip
typical_fix: Replace the kick ratchet gear, replace the kick return spring, or overhaul/replace the clutch plates.

issue_description: key cylinder loose, ignition key falling out, key doesnt turn switch
likely_causes: Worn out ignition lock key tumbler
typical_fix: Replace the complete key lock set (ignition, fuel cap, seat lock) or rebuild tumbler pins.

issue_description: engine missing fire, engine hesitates, bike makes puffing sounds
likely_causes: Water entry in spark plug cap
typical_fix: Blow air to dry out the spark plug cap, inspect/replace the HT coil, and clean the petrol strainer.

issue_description: front tyre wearing unevenly, bike handles weird in turns
typical_fix: Perform wheel alignment/balancing, inspect and align front fork tubes, or replace front wheel bearings.
